csv_project_name: Conslt for FY26 Teton Co SH-33 Congestion Traffic Study
csv_scope_of_work: The Idaho Transportation Department (ITD) is seeking qualified and experienced respondents from interested firms to submit a proposal for providing Project Development services for the FY26 D-6 Planning & Scoping project. This scope of work describes the tasks to be performed by the Consultant for conducting a traffic study of SH-33 that will evaluate the capacity, safety, and operational performance of the transportation system and its ability to accommodate existing and future transportation needs; if, when and how the system could fail, identify methods to mitigate system failure; and propose projects that reduce overall congestion to improve safety and capacity issues along SH-33 in Teton Valley.
csv_disciplines_requested: Civil Engineering, Planning/Master Planning, Traffic Design Engineering, Traffic Studies
